_comment: The Summoner's creatures (designer session 2026-09-05). Every entry uses the MONSTER vocabulary from monsters.json — hp, ac (a bonus over 10, like a monster's), to_hit, damage (dice), attacks, speed (2 = acts on even rounds only), save, family, element, bonus_damage {dice, element}, inflicts {condition, rounds, dc}, resist_physical — so you tune a summon exactly the way you tune a monster. No xp: a summon never awards any. Summon-only fields: 'magic': true = its blows count as ENCHANTED and bite magic_to_hit monsters (the designer's ruling: druid elementals and shaman spirit warriors and up; wisps, wolves, bears and the first spirit cannot); 'attack_kind': edged | piercing | blunt = what its blows are for resist_physical (a bite is piercing, a paw is blunt); 'riposte': true = whenever a monster's melee blow lands on it, it strikes straight back (the fey spirit — a Bladesinger's trick); 'plural' = how several are named (Wolves); 'icon' = the emoji the sidebar badge wears while it lives. Which creature a hero calls, at what level and cost, lives in classes.json (the pre-fork wisp) and progression.json (each lane's 'summons' ladder). ALL NUMBERS ARE PROPOSALS scaled off the monster curve of the floors the band is met on — retune freely.

wisp.name: Wisp
wisp._comment: Levels 1-4: a floating light with a weak arcane touch. Two of them from level 3.

bear.name: Bear
bear._comment: Druid band 10-14: two claws a round.

elemental_fire.name: Fire Elemental
elemental_fire._comment: Druid band 15-19, the caller picks the element at each call. Art shared with the monster of the same name.

spirit_of_the_elements.name: Spirit of the Elements
spirit_of_the_elements._comment: The Druid's Rite summon (level 20): every spell point, once a battle.

spirit.name: Spirit
spirit._comment: Shaman band 5-9: a bare spirit with a melee blow. Cannot bite magic_to_hit foes — the Spirit Edge verse fixes that.

spirit_warrior.name: Spirit Warrior
spirit_warrior._comment: Shaman band 10-14: its ghost-blade is magic in itself.

fey_spirit.name: Fey Spirit
fey_spirit._comment: Shaman band 15-19: a bladesinger of the fey court — every blow that lands on it is answered.

spirit_of_the_ancestors.name: Spirit of the Ancestors
spirit_of_the_ancestors._comment: The Shaman's Rite summon (level 20): every spell point, once a battle.
